_meta.how_to_apply: ffmpeg -ss start_s -to end_s -i <file> -af afade=t=in:d=0.002,afade=t=out:st=(end-start-fade_out_s):d=fade_out_s,volume=<gain_db>dB -ar 22050 -ac 1 out.wav. Gains measured on 44.1 kHz stereo/mono source; short (<0.6 s) sounds target peak -3 dBFS capped at -12 LUFS, longer ones -16 LUFS integrated capped at -1.5 dBFS peak (ambient -20 LUFS). Pre-rendered previews of every primary (<name>.wav) and alternate (<name>__alt.wav) are in data/.cache/sfx-candidates/_preview/.
_meta.listening_note: Selections were made from names, descriptions, durations, envelopes and spectral centroids only - nobody has listened. Audition the _preview files before shipping.
